description:
Overall Purpose of the Role

We are looking for a Software Tester to join the DevApp Mobile team and work on a strategic project developed for our client, TRiBECA® Knowledge, a London (UK) based company delivering software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions to the pharmaceutical industry across Europe and the US.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining test plans, designing and automating test cases, constructing test scenarios and scripts, and executing tests to ensure the quality and reliability of our SaaS platforms. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Software Developers, Product Managers, and UX/UI Designers to validate product functionality and report test results clearly and accurately.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Test Planning & Design (30%)

  • Definition of test plans aligned with product requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Definition of test cases covering functional, integration, regression, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Construction of test scenarios and scripts to support structured, repeatable, and traceable testing activities.
  • Ensure comprehensive test coverage across new features and existing functionality.

Test Automation (30%)

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using appropriate frameworks and tools (e.g. Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality feedback across the development lifecycle.
  • Build and expand regression test suites to protect product stability across releases.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and reduce reliance on manual testing over time.

Test Execution & Coordination (25%)

  • Coordination and execution of tests across sprint cycles and release milestones.
  • Collaborate with development and product teams to validate fixes, improvements, and new features.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identify, log, and track defects through to resolution using Jira.
  • Collaborate closely with the UX/UI Designer to review designs for testability, flag usability issues early, and validate that implemented interfaces match design specifications.

Reporting & Quality Assurance (10%)

  • Reporting of test results, including defect tracking, test coverage metrics, and overall quality status.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date test documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and best practices.

Information Security & Quality (5%)

  • Apply security-by-design and privacy-by-design principles throughout testing activities.
  • Contribute to quality and compliance practices aligned with ISO 27001.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Minimum 2 years of IT professional experience.
  • Minimum 1 year of IS testing experience.
  • Proven knowledge of testing technologies and tools.
  • Hands-on experience writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and integrating automated tests into build pipelines.
  • Capability to integrate in an international/multi-cultural environment, with rapid self-starting capability and experience working in a team.
  • Good communication skills and strong aptitude for reporting.
  • Ability to adapt to fast-changing technologies used in application development.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Standard Benefits

  • Competitive salary package
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Collaborative, international working environment

About Us

DevApp Mobile is a Romanian software development company based in Bucharest, specialized in custom software solutions, AI-driven business automation, web platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and mobile applications for Android and iOS. Our team delivers scalable and secure mobile solutions tailored to real business needs, integrating modern cloud architectures, REST APIs, and intuitive administration systems. Since 2015, DevApp has worked with startups and international clients across industries such as healthcare, tourism, logistics, recruitment, and e-commerce, building both web and mobile platforms designed to optimize workflows and automate business operations.

About Our Client

TRiBECA® Knowledge provides cloud-based tools loved by the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. Our mission is to empower the pharmaceutical industry to bring life-changing therapies to more patients faster. Everything we do is guided by this purpose – from how our flagship SmartLaunch® platform simplifies and accelerates the launch of new medicines, to how we enable collaboration, efficiency, and ease of use across global teams.
